text:
Lessons from upgrading our primary Postgres database from 11 to 16 with under 5 minutes of downtime:

1. Logical replication worked, but sequences don't replicate. We scripted setval for all 140 sequences at cutover.
2. Large objects aren't replicated either. Three tables used them; we moved those blobs to object storage a month earlier.
3. Run ANALYZE on the new primary before switching traffic. Our first rehearsal skipped it and p95 latency went from 40ms to 900ms.
4. Rehearse the cutover on a production-sized snapshot. It took us three rehearsals to get under 5 minutes.
5. Keep the old primary as a read-only fallback for 72 hours. We didn't need it, but it made the go/no-go call easy.

Full runbook on our engineering blog: https://example.com/blog/pg16-migration

🧪 Small pytest change that cut our test suite by 6 minutes:

❌ Creating a fresh database per test
✅ One database per session, each test wrapped in a transaction that rolls back

🔧 How: a session-scoped fixture for the engine, plus a function-scoped fixture that opens a connection, begins a transaction, yields a session bound to it, then calls rollback().

⏱️ 1,840 tests: 9m12s → 3m05s

⚠️ Caveat: code that commits explicitly needs nested transactions (SAVEPOINT), or it will escape the rollback.

We cut our paid search budget by 40% in Q3 and moved the money into webinars and partner co-marketing.

Pipeline from paid search fell 22%, but total qualified pipeline was up 9% and blended CAC dropped from $1,900 to $1,350.

I'll write up the full channel breakdown after our team offsite next week.

label: none
text: A discovery call habit that has helped me: at the end of each call I summarize the customer's problem in one sentence and ask them to correct it. About a third of the time they do, and that correction is usually the most useful thing I hear on the call.

label: none
text: Closed our books for October in 6 business days, down from 11 in January. The main changes: daily bank reconciliations instead of month-end, a shared accruals template for department heads, and moving intercompany invoicing to the 25th of each month.

label: none
text: Our hospital's sepsis screening pilot finished its first six months. In the emergency department, median time from triage to first antibiotic dose fell from 94 to 61 minutes. We're extending the pilot to the two medical admissions wards in January.

label: none
text: Trying something new with my Year 10 history class: instead of a final essay, students are producing a five-minute podcast episode arguing a position on a primary source. The rubric covers use of evidence, handling of counterarguments, and clarity. First recordings are due next Friday.

label: none
text: A note for candidates: if you're asked for salary expectations and don't want to name a number first, it's reasonable to ask for the band instead. Most of the companies I recruit for will share it, and in a growing number of US states employers are required to include it in the job posting.

text:
Shipped a refresh of our design system's form components today:

- Error states now use an icon and text, not just a red border
- Consistent 44px minimum touch targets
- A documented pattern for when inline validation should fire

Migration guide is in the internal docs; the old components will be removed at the end of Q1.

Gave my first conference talk yesterday, on running accessibility checks in CI. Slides and the sample pipeline config are here: https://example.com/talks/a11y-ci

Thanks to everyone who asked about false positives from automated checkers. I'll write a follow-up on how we triage them.

text: Our volunteer team finished digitizing 3,200 paper intake forms from the food bank's 2019–2023 archive. For the first time we have a reliable picture of how visiting household sizes changed over that period, and we'll present the findings to the board next month.

label: none
text: Small HR process change with a noticeable effect: our offer letters now open with a one-page summary listing salary, start date, equity, notice period and benefits start date. Questions from new hires in their first week have dropped by roughly half.

label: none
text:
Our open-source CSV validation library reached version 2.0 this week.

Main changes:
- Streaming mode for files larger than memory
- Schema definitions in YAML
- A 3x speedup on wide files, thanks to a contributor who rewrote type inference

Upgrade notes are in the changelog.

label: none
text: Finished a 10-week evening course in clinical trial data management. The most useful module was on SDTM mapping, which finally explained why our sponsor kept sending back our dataset submissions.

label: none
text: Warehouse update: switching from batch picking to zone picking on our two busiest shifts reduced average order cycle time from 47 to 31 minutes. Mis-pick rates were flat. We'll trial it on the weekend shift next.

label: none
text: Ten years at the same credit union today. I started as a teller and now lead the member lending team of 14. The biggest change over that time: loan decisions that used to take a week now take an afternoon, mostly because we finally integrated our core banking and document systems.
